description: Version 2 SHA-256 bindings. Recipe fingerprints include recipe id, servings, ordered ingredient identities, amounts, units, calculation-relevant ingredient states, and ordered cooking_method steps; free preparation prose, notes, punctuation, and formatting are ignored. Calculation-input fingerprints include mappings, portions, conversions, numeric assumptions, and evidence-presence flags. Calculation-evidence fingerprints track source record identity, carbohydrate values/basis/state, GI values, food/preparation keys, and source quality fields while ignoring irrelevant titles/retrieval metadata. Mismatches block publication until reviewed.
